contexts.text: (Some Spirits) relatively to the Lord (are in) a horizontal plane...
I seemed to be gradually elevated from the horizontal plane.
Our Sun... stands constantly in the midst between the zenith and the horizon... TCR 29:2.
He was thrown down horizontally... Thus he was turned horizontally... SE 1696:2. SE 1806.
He appeared like a sphere of horizontal rotation...

They rotated themselves horizontally, as is the case in the Vitus's dance, which signified that they wanted to exhibit themselves as innocent before the eyes of others who were present, and thus to withdraw themselves from their sight; for it is their ideas which are thus represented...
